title: Champagne and Bullets belongs on the Mount Rushmore of bad movies
summary: The movie is almost entirely the work of one man, John De Hart. There are three uncomfortably long sex scenes with costar Pamela Bryant, who plays Cindy, all set to songs sung by Hart.
